text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Criminal Procedure Code (Qualified Persons) Notification 2010 and shall come into operation on 2nd January 2011.
3. The Criminal Procedure Code (Report of Experts) (Consolidation) Notification (Cap. 68, N 1) is cancelled.
